documents.text: Edward William Day Edward William Day (May 24, 1901 – October 22, 1985) was a United States District Judge of the United States District Court for the District of Rhode Island. Born in Cranston, Rhode Island, Day received a Bachelor of Philosophy degree from Brown University in 1922 and a Bachelor of Laws from Harvard Law School in 1925. He was in private practice in Providence, Rhode Island from 1925 to 1930, and was a law clerk for the Eighth District Court of Rhode Island from 1929 to 1930.
